Insert Image description: Paste any image URL, including a Google Drive link. To upload a new image to Google Drive, enable Google Drive Sync and drag and drop the image into the note.

Enable Google Drive Sync detail.description: Creates a My Notes folder in your Google Drive (once) and uses it to back up your notes. Notes are synced to and from Google Drive when the feature is enabled, and then every time you click the Sync now button in the Sidebar.

Why sync reasons.reason1: A backup of your notes (notes can be restored)
Why sync reasons.reason2: Edit notes in Google Drive or other apps, and see the changes in My Notes
Why sync reasons.reason3: Sync and edit notes on other computers (install My Notes and use the same Google Account)

Permission details.detail1: My Notes can only access the files it created. It cannot see other files in your Google Drive.
Permission details.detail2: My Notes asks for permission when you enable this feature.

Enable Google Drive Sync detail.Enable Auto Sync description: Auto Sync syncs your notes to and from Google Drive every time you open My Notes, and every 6 seconds if your local notes changed since the last sync.

Indent text on Tab detail.description: By default, the Tab key moves focus between the address bar and the note. Enable this to indent the text instead.
